1000-miglia-native-joystick-dpad-inferre.description: Native joystick driving: D-pad Up accelerates, Down brakes, Left/Right steer; A alone downshifts and A+Up upshifts. X headlights, Select map, L1 pause, Start returns to selections.

120-degrees-below-zero-dpad-mouse-parser.description: Low-confidence control-panel mapping for the DOS SCI0 adventure: D-pad moves the mouse pointer, A=Space use, B=Enter start/select, Start=Esc menu. Typed parser commands still need the virtual keyboard; native joystick support is unverified.

1830-dpad-mouse-keyboard-v1.description: Mouse-first DOS board-game layout: D-pad moves the pointer, A left-clicks, X confirms with Enter, and Start sends Esc to cancel/back. Use the virtual keyboard for names and any text prompts.

1942-pacific-air-war-dpad-native-joystic.description: D-pad maps to the native flight joystick; A fires guns, B is joystick button 2. Face and shoulder buttons trigger documented flight actions.

1993tris-dpad-keys-low-v1.description: Low-confidence 1993tris layout: D-pad left/right/down move pieces; Up provisionally rotates left; A=End rotates right; B=Space activates the gun/weight. The title-specific page does not expose the move/left-rotate key names.

1st-person-pinball-keyboard-v1.description: Keyboard-only pinball layout: A=W left flipper, B=Shift+/ sends ? for right flipper, X=Enter confirms menus, Start=Space starts/launches. DOS sources list keyboard input and no joystick; nudge controls are undocumented.

2-fast-4-you-native-joystick-space-v1.description: Native DOS joystick steering: D-pad sends joystick 1 directions; A sends the documented Space power-up key. Exact DOS sources do not document a joystick button role for power-ups.

3-demon-keyboard-v1.description: Arrow-key maze movement: D-pad up advances, left/right turn, down descends after half the food; A turns around (5), B exits (Esc), X opens help (H), Y shows the map (NumPad +).

3-skulls-toltecs-dpad-mouse-native-v1.description: Exact DOS manual: D-pad moves mouse pointer; A=left-click to walk, select objects, and choose commands; B=right-click for highlighted default actions and talk. X=Esc skips cutscenes; Y=F10 opens the DOS Options menu. Text entry when naming saves needs the virtual keyboard.

3d-ball-dpad-wadx-inferred-v1.description: Low-confidence keyboard layout: D-pad Up=W, Left=A, Right=D, Down=X.

3d-bomber-keyboard-v1.description: Keyboard action layout: D-pad arrows move, L1/R1 with Alt+arrow strafe, B drops bombs (Ctrl), X types chat (T), Start quits (Esc).

3d-cyberpuck-joystick-v1.description: Prioritize native DOS joystick input: D-pad drives joystick 1; A is joystick button 1 and B sends the documented Space shoot/punch key as a fallback. X/Y/L1/R1 select weapons 1/2/3/4; L2/R2/Select/Start select Q/W/E/R. The profile avoids both analog sticks.

3d-hamsters-keyboard-v1.description: D-pad arrows move through the platform levels and inventory; A=Space kick/throw grenade, B=Enter pick up/use items, X=J jump, Y/L1=1/2 switch attack mode, R1=S inventory, Select=F1 hint, Start=P pause.

3d-pinball-1992-keyboard-v1.description: Keyboard-only pinball controls for the 1992 DOS release: D-pad left/right operate the Z/M flippers, A=Space starts or launches, B/X=N/X activate the two air jets, and L1/R1=F1/F2 change the view. No native joystick is listed for DOS.

3detris-keyboard-mouse-v1.description: Digital keyboard/mouse layout: D-pad arrows navigate 3D space; A rotates a piece (left click), B drops with Space, Y drops with right click, L1+R1 fly backward, L1+A fly forward, L2+Y changes arrow functions, Select starts a game, Start exits.

4d-prince-of-persia-dpad-keyboard-v1.description: DOS keyboard controls: D-pad arrows run/jump/crouch/climb; hold A=Shift with Left/Right for careful walking, and A alone drinks potions, grabs ledges, draws the sword, or strikes. B=Space shows time remaining; Start=Esc pauses. No joystick scheme is documented.

4k-adventure-parser-v1.description: Text-adventure shortcuts: D-pad enters N/S/W/E, A submits with Enter, B enters Look (L), X Examine (X), Y Inventory (I). Use the virtual keyboard for other verb-noun commands and GO/QUIT.

4x4-offroad-racing-dos-native-joystick-v.description: Native joystick driving: D-pad directions map to joystick 1; A sends fire/start/accelerate; X sends Space for documented in-race repairs.

5th-fleet-dpad-mouse-hotkeys-v1.description: Mouse-first DOS wargame layout: D-pad moves the pointer; A/B left/right click. X=E executes orders, Y=R opens Tactical Reference, L1=P and R1=N browse previous/next active unit on the Operations Display, and Start=Esc uses the screen-specific exit/back command. Pointer actions including dragging remain essential; keyboard is needed for full access.

a10-tank-killer-dpad-native-joystick-v1.description: Low-confidence native joystick layout for the 1989 DOS release. D-pad up=joystick 1 down (climb), down=joystick 1 up (dive), left/right=joystick 1 left/right; A/B=joystick 1 buttons 1/2 (cannon/selected weapon). X=F flare, Y=C chaff, L1=Tab next HUD/TID target, R1=Shift+= next active weapon, L2/R2 cycle throttle keys 1-9, Select=M map, Start=Esc control panel/pause. Vertical joystick menus move opposite the flight mapping; Tab advances menu hot pads. Throttle cycling is not state synchronized.

a2-player4-native-joystick-v1.description: Native Player 4 joystick controls on the D-pad and face buttons: up thrusts, left/right turn, A shoots, B fires the special weapon, Start pauses. Center the joystick before game initialization.

abductor-joystick-v1.description: Native joystick movement after J enables it; documented keyboard fire, smart-bomb, hyperspace, calibration, pause, and menu actions.

abmis-the-lion-keyboard-v1.description: Documented keyboard movement, jump, shoot, and pick-up/drop actions.

absolute-pinball-dpad-keyboard-v1.description: Exact DOS pinball keyboard map: D-pad Left/Right use the two flippers and Up nudges upward; A launches, B nudges right, X selects one player, Start pauses/options.

abuse-dpad-arrow-movement-button-aim-v1.description: D-pad sends the DOS cursor keys for character control; A fires with left mouse, B uses the right-mouse special ability, and X/Y/L1/R1 move the mouse aim left/right/up/down. L2 selects the previous weapon and R2 the next. This keeps character movement on the D-pad and avoids analog sticks; aiming uses four face/shoulder directions.

abyss-of-pandemonium-quake-v1.description: D-pad drives the native joystick; A/B send joystick buttons 1/2 (bind them to attack/jump in Quake setup). X/Y navigate menus with arrow keys. L1 cycles weapons 1-9; Start opens the menu, Select confirms.

ace-of-aces-native-joystick-dpad-j-selec.description: At startup, Start sends J to select the manual's joystick mode. The D-pad controls native joystick 1 directions, A fires joystick button 1, and X sends F7 for status/pause. This is a medium-confidence default: the IBM PC/Tandy manual documents joystick and one fire button but does not number that button; keyboard shortcuts remain useful for several flight and screen functions.

aces-high-keyboard-v1.description: Keyboard movement and action keys with menu/select and Escape access.

aces-of-the-deep-dpad-mouse-v1.description: Manual-backed mouse-first DOS layout: D-pad moves the pointer, A/B left/right-click; X selects a target, screen shortcuts open main command stations, Select resets time, Start pauses.

aces-of-the-pacific-dpad-joy1-actions-v1.description: Aces of the Pacific: D-pad drives native Joystick 1 flight axes; A fires guns with Joystick 1 button 1. Buttons map to documented DOS flight actions; choose Joystick 1 in the Preferences panel.

aces-over-europe-dpad-native-v1.description: Exact DOS flight-sim mapping: D-pad drives Joystick 1, A fires the selected gun, face/shoulder buttons send documented weapon/flight keys, Select opens preferences, Start pauses.

acid-tetris-keyboard-v1.description: Tetris controls: D-pad arrows move the falling piece; A sends S to rotate; Start sends Enter for menu choices.

ack-man-keyboard-v1.description: Arrow-key movement with Insert pause/resume and Escape exit.

acquire-numeric-entry-v1.description: Keyboard numeric-entry layout: D-pad types 1 through 4; A-D type 5 through 8; L1=9, R1=0; L2=F1, R2=F3; Select=Backspace, Start=Enter.

advanced-destroyer-native-joystick-comma.description: D-pad sends joystick 1 directions for ship steering/speed; A sends joystick button 1 to fire. B=F3 cannons, X=F4 port torpedoes, Y=F6 map, Select=F1 command post, Start=F10 pause. L1/R1 send keypad 4/6 to train guns/tubes; L2/R2 send keypad 2/8 to lower/raise cannon elevation.

adventure-magicland-parser-v1.description: Text adventure: D-pad enters N/S/W/E, A submits with Enter, B opens inventory (I), X opens help (H), Y quits (Q). Use the app keyboard for other verb-noun commands.

adventure-math-keyboard-v1.description: Hybrid keyboard controls: D-pad left/right move in the bonus round; A fires with Space; B confirms with Enter; X/Y select addition/subtraction (A/S); L1 pauses (P); Start returns to menu (Esc). Use the app keyboard for name, level, and numeric-answer fields.

after-burner-native-joystick-inverted-pi.description: IBM DOS flight layout: physical D-pad up sends joystick pull-back to climb, down sends joystick forward to dive, left/right send joystick left/right, A/B send joystick buttons 1/2, and Start sends Ctrl+P pause. Hold A+B with D-pad left/right to roll or up/down to decelerate/accelerate.

air-strike-mouse-turret-v1.description: Mouse-controlled turret: D-pad moves the pointer; A fires with left click; B launches grenades with right click; X/Y/L1/R1/L2/R2 select weapons 1-6; Start opens the Escape menu.

air-troubles-p1-keyboard-v1.description: Player 1 keyboard layout: D-pad arrows move, A fires the cannon (Enter), B fires the secondary weapon (Right Shift), and Start returns to the main menu (Esc).

airlift-rescue-native-joystick-v1.description: Native joystick controls on digital inputs: D-pad up/down are inverted at the DOS joystick to keep up ascending and down descending; left/right map directly. A=joystick button 1 fire, B=button 2 facing, Start=Esc options.

airstrike-keyboard-v1.description: Arrow-key flight, guns, missiles, and documented Ctrl-Q exit.

aj-quest-native-joystick-v1.description: D-pad sends native joystick 1 directions; A sends Space (best-weapon attack), B sends P (pick up), X sends D (drop item), Start sends F8 (toggle joystick), and Select sends F9 (calibrate).

alchemy-game-mouse-v1.description: D-pad moves the mouse; A left-clicks and B right-clicks, supporting symbol drag and group selection. X=F1 help, Y=F2 save, L1=F3 load, R1=F5 discoveries, L2=F6 next discoveries, Select=O sort symbols.

aldos-adventure-keyboard-v1.description: Keyboard platform controls on the D-pad and buttons: arrows run/climb, A jumps with Space, Start exits with Esc.

alex2-mouse-board-v1.description: D-pad moves the mouse pointer, A left-clicks for board actions, X requests the documented H move suggestion, and Start exits with Esc.

alien-alley-native-joystick-fire-inferre.description: Low-confidence DOS joystick layout: D-pad sends native joystick 1 directions; A sends joystick button 1 as an inferred fire action. L1 sends J to select joystick mode; X sends S for scores.

alien-assault-1997-keyboard-v1.description: D-pad arrows move the marine; A=Alt fire weapon or activate a computer, B=Ctrl run, Select=F1 options menu.

alien-cabal-joystick-v1.description: Native joystick profile: configure SETUP for joystick axes, button 1=Fire, and button 2=Look Forward (hold with D-pad up/down to look vertically). D-pad drives joystick 1; X=Space activates doors/lifts, Y=End returns view forward, L1=Tab map, R1/L2/R2/Select=weapons 1-4, Start=Esc menu. Weapon 5 is not separately bound.

alien-phobia-keyboard-v1.description: Keyboard-only DOS scheme: D-pad up advances, left/right turn; hold A (Enter) to fire continuously.

amazon-guardians-mouse-keyboard-v1.description: D-pad moves the mouse cursor and A clicks. B/X/Y/L1/R1/L2/R2/Select/Start map to the documented F2-F10 command keys: Look, Move/Open, Get, Inventory, Climb, Talk, Exit, Help, Save/Load.

amazon-queen-dpad-mouse-v1.description: D-pad moves the mouse pointer; A clicks left and B clicks right. X opens the journal (F1), Y skips speech (Space), and Start skips cutscenes or closes the journal (Esc).

angel-nieto-pole-500-native-joystick-inf.description: Low-confidence native joystick preset: D-pad drives joystick 1 directions; Start returns to menu using documented PC keys. The PC Break pause key has no supported guest-key mapping here; joystick button roles are unspecified.

another-pool-mouse-v1.description: Mouse-driven pool play: D-pad moves the pointer; A left-clicks to shoot, B right-clicks for cue-ball positioning and hit-point/power actions. X=Enter provides the documented left-click keyboard equivalent; Start=N new game; Select=Esc quit. Current bindings have no middle mouse button, so the manual's middle+right advanced curve-ball chord is unavailable.

antkill-keyboard-command-pad-v1.description: Manual-backed keyboard command pad: D-pad up/down step/strike and left/right turn; A get, B drop, X inventory, Y examine, L1 wear, R1 Shift+P put in pack, L2 jump, R2 run, Start Shift+S status, Select Shift+slash help.

apba-pro-football-home-coach-dpad-v1.description: D-pad navigates menus. A/B/X/Y/L1/R1/L2 enter home-coach calls 4/5/6/7/8/9/0; R2=P ready; Start=Enter activates; Select=Escape.

apocalypse-abyss-dpad-keyboard-actions-v.description: D-pad arrows move. A=Space bomb, B=Ctrl dagger, X=Alt wand, L1+direction=Shift+arrow face without moving, Y=Enter confirm, Start=Escape.

apshai-trilogy-dos-keyboard-v1.description: IBM PC keyboard layout from the Trilogy instructions: D-pad sends cursor arrows; A=Attack; B=Thrust. The DOS-specific joystick card was not available, and the IBM PC input listing names keyboard only.

arithmetic-games-set-1-math-entry-inferr.description: Low-confidence text-entry layout: D-pad types digits 8/2/4/6; A submits with Enter; B/X/Y/Select type plus, minus, multiply, and divide; Start types 0; L1/R1 cycle 1/3/5/7/9; L2 sends Shift+9 for ( and R2 sends Shift+0 for ). Avoid Ctrl/Alt because the original game can freeze under DOSBox.

aro-ii-native-joystick-inferred-v1.description: Low-confidence joystick-axis inference: D-pad sends joystick 1 directions corresponding to jump/move/duck; A sends documented Ctrl run. Select and calibrate joystick in Settings.

asteroid-pilot-shift-thrust-v1.description: Single-action keyboard control: A sends Left Shift for upward thrust. The game moves horizontally on its own, so no directional binding is documented.

astro-blaster-documented-functions-v1.description: A=laser, B=timewarp, Start=pause/exit; L1/R1 select one/two players in menus. Movement keys are undocumented.

astro3d-native-joystick-v1.description: Native joystick controls: D-pad steers via joystick axes; A=joystick button 1 fire, B=button 2 thrust. X=Enter menu select; L1/R1=menu up/down; Y/L2/R2/Select select weapons 1-4 (4 registered only); Start=Space hyperspace. Calibrate on first launch or in Options.

atac-native-joystick-dpad-weapons-v1.description: Native DOS joystick flight controls: D-pad sends joystick 1 left/right/dive/climb; A presses joystick button 1 as the documented selector. B=Return fires the selected weapon, X=Backspace fires the cannon, and Start=Esc returns to the prior screen. Throttle, rudder, and aircraft-specific controls remain on the keyboard.

avenger-keyboard-player-one-v1.description: Player 1: D-pad arrows move the ship; A=Right Alt primary fire; B=Right Ctrl secondary fire; Start=Esc menu.

avish-keyboard-platform-puzzle-v1.description: D-pad arrows provide directional movement/jump/elevator equivalents for documented cursor keys 4/6/8/2. A=Space item pickup/drop, B=Enter use item, X=P room view, Y=C held item, L1=M music, R1=S sound, Start=Esc quit/restart.

ball-game-native-joystick-v1.description: D-pad left/right cycle available moves with native joystick 1; A selects with joystick button 1; Start=F10 exits.

balltris-keyboard-v1.description: Keyboard fallback for movement, rotation, drop, effects, pause; keypad 5 is approximated by the available digit 5 key.

bardarts-keyboard-aim-v1.description: D-pad positions the aim cursor; A=Enter sets/starts the clockmeter sequence; X=C changes cursor color; L1/R1=PgUp/PgDn cursor step size. Space reset is unbound.

batman-forever-dos-native-joystick-2butt.description: Native two-button DOS joystick: D-pad drives Joystick 1 directions; A=button 1 Jump, B=button 2 Kick, X sends the manual-documented Player 1 key 3 for Punch/Fire Gadget. No analog sticks.

batter-up-arithmetic-keyboard-low-v1.description: Low-confidence keyboard layout for Batter Up (DOS 1992): D-pad arrows for likely menu navigation, A=Enter to select or submit, B=Backspace to correct. Arithmetic and fraction answers still require the app keyboard; no joystick support or these key bindings are verified in the available exact-release sources.

battle-fleet-keyboard-v1.description: Keyboard grid navigation and shot confirmation with coordinate correction, sound, and quit controls.

bc-racers-joystick-steering-keyboard-act.description: D-pad left/right send native joystick 1 steering. A=Q accelerate; B=A brake; X=Tab punch/nitro; Y=P pause.

beyond-columns-keyboard-gamepad-low-v1.description: Low-confidence Beyond Columns keyboard layout: D-pad Left/Right move; A=Space rotates, B=Enter drops; Start=P pauses; Select=Q boss key. The accessible exact-game source omits rotate/drop key labels, so Space/Enter are inferred.

bingo-granny-text-prompts-v1.description: Text-only DOS game: A=Enter advances bingo numbers, B=N and X=Y answer the documented yes/no prompts. Multiple-choice option entry still needs the virtual keyboard because its selection keys are not documented.

bipbop-ii-mouse-v1.description: D-pad moves the mouse cursor and paddle; A/B click to select or fire. Select returns to the previous screen with Esc; Start pauses with P. Configure mouse control in game Setup.

bird-brain-dpad-joystick-horizontal-flap.description: Low-confidence joystick-first DOS layout: D-pad left/right=joystick 1 horizontal directions; A=joystick button 1 inferred flap; B=Space documented flap fallback. The game only documents horizontal steering and flapping. Joystick support conflicts across DOS sources.

blockage-mouse-v1.description: Use D-pad left/right to move the mouse-controlled paddle; A sends a mouse click as a provisional launch/action input (low confidence).

bloodwings-dpad-actions-v1.description: Bloodwings DOS controls: D-pad moves; A=Space fire, B=Enter 180 turn, X=I inventory, Y=Esc menu, L1=Alt sidestep, R1=H hand cursor.

bobs-dragon-hunt-command-keys-v1.description: D-pad Left/Right turns with keypad +/-; A=Enter, B=Get, X=Wear, Y=Drop, L1=Status, R1=Examine, L2=Cast, Start=Escape. Use the virtual keyboard for the command list.

boxzum-native-joystick-v1.description: D-pad sends native joystick 1 directions; L1 selects joystick mode with J during setup; A starts with Enter; Start sends Esc to return to the main menu.

breakout-1991-dpad-mouse-movement-inferr.description: Low-confidence mouse movement default for the 1991 Ken Silverman DOS Breakout: the D-pad moves the mouse in four directions to steer its two-axis paddle. Mouse-button actions are undocumented and left unassigned.

bricks-1984-dpad-capslock-insert-v1.description: Bricks (1984) keyboard paddle control: D-pad Left sends Caps Lock; D-pad Right sends Insert. No face-button action is documented.

brix-horizontal-cursor-space-pick-v1.description: Shared controller binding layout. The game-specific research row documents action meanings, input mode, and setup requirements.

brokeout-dpad-mouse-horizontal-inferred-.description: Low-confidence paddle mapping: D-pad Left/Right emulate horizontal mouse movement; no button action is assigned.

bruce-lee-native-joystick-with-start-pau.description: Native joystick directions: D-pad moves, jumps, climbs, leaps, and ducks; A sends joystick button 1 for the context-sensitive strike or chop. L1=P pause, Start=Enter start/show status, Select=Esc return to title.

brudal-baddle-native-dpad-keyed-actions-.description: D-pad sends native joystick 1 directions for move, jump, and duck. A=period punch and B=slash kick, using the documented player-one keyboard actions because joystick button roles are not documented.

brutal-sports-football-native-joystick-v.description: D-pad sends native joystick 1 directions. A=Fire 1 (joystick button 1), B=Fire 2 (joystick button 2), X=Fire 3 (documented default key Q because KairoDos exposes only two buttons for joystick 1). Start=Tab pause.

bubble-blobb-ii-joystick-v1.description: Native joystick movement and Action; J enables joystick, shoulder shifts provide alternate keyboard steering. Enter and Space are documented suicide keys; joystick button 1 is documented as Action.

bubble-bobble-1988-native-joystick-v1.description: Native joystick 1: D-pad moves Bub/Bob left/right/up; A fires to blow bubbles and also starts/continues. L1=F1 pause, Select=F10 exit. Up rides bubbles; use the DOS setup menu to configure keyboard or player 2.

bubble-ghost-dpad-mouse-clicks-blow-v1.description: Shared controller binding layout. The game-specific research row documents action meanings, input mode, and setup requirements.

budokan-native-joystick-configuration-v1.description: Native joystick 1: D-pad moves through directional attack sequences and A is the joystick Action button. B bows/stops sparring. Start=Esc opens game configuration. Menus and Player 1/2 selection still need keyboard digits and Enter.

bug-adventure-dpad-navigation-v1.description: D-pad arrows move the on-screen pointer; A=Enter for selection and B=left-click. Use mouse click for any item that does not accept Enter.

bumpy-1989-dos-native-joystick-v1.description: DOS manual-backed native joystick layout: D-pad left/right moves; D-pad down brakes; A sends joystick button 1 to jump. X sends D for the documented discovery command, L1 sends P to pause, and Select sends Escape to return to the options menu. D-pad up is left unmapped because the DOS manual does not document an up-direction action.

bunny-bricks-native-joystick-fire-inferr.description: Shared controller binding layout. The game-specific research row documents action meanings, input mode, and setup requirements.

c-dogs-native-joystick-two-button-v1.description: Native joystick defaults: D-pad moves, A=Button 1 fire/menu select, B=Button 2 cycles weapons (tap) or slides (hold then direction). L1=Tab map, Start=Esc pause/abort; press any other control to resume.

cadaver-dos-native-joystick-actions-v1.description: Native DOS joystick: D-pad moves in 4/8 directions, A=joystick fire for jump/use/throw and icon activation, B=Enter rucksack, L1=F1 map, R1=F2 map center, X=H held-item toggle, Y=F5 save, Select=F6 load, Start=F7 pause.

caesar-1992-dos-dpad-mouse-hotkeys-v1.description: Caesar (PC DOS): D-pad moves the mouse pointer; A=left click, B=right click. X=F1 Empire map, Y=F2 Province, L1=F3 City, R1=Space toolbar cycle, L2=T pause/scroll mode, R2=F Forum, Select=G Maps Panel, Start=P position indicator.

caesar-ii-dos-required-mouse-hotkeys-v1.description: Caesar II (DOS): mouse is required; D-pad moves pointer, A=left click, B=right click. X=F1 City, Y=F2 Forum, L1=1 closest zoom, R1=2 medium zoom, L2=3 farthest zoom, R2=Space cancel construction, Start=P pause.

cannon-fodder-mouse-v1.description: Mouse pointer controls movement and aiming; hold B (right click) and press A (left click) for grenades/rockets; Y opens the map.

captain-comic-keyboard-v1.description: Keyboard movement and actions on the D-pad and buttons: left/right move, A jumps, B fires, X opens doors, Y teleports, Start pauses/quits.

carmen-sandiego-1985-native-joystick-v1.description: Native DOS joystick menu controls for Where in the World Is Carmen Sandiego? (1985): D-pad controls joystick 1; A/B are joystick buttons 1/2; Select sends Ctrl+I to enable joystick mode; Start sends Esc to return to the menu.

catacomb-abyss-native-joystick-v1.description: Native DOS joystick scheme: D-pad moves/turns, A fires, B strafes. X uses a potion, Y fires a bolt, L1 fires a nuke, Select opens help, L2 opens the control panel, Start pauses, and R1/R2 save/load.

caverns-city-keyboard-adventure-v1.description: D-pad enters uppercase compass commands; A submits. B is inventory, X looks, Y climbs up, and L1 goes down. Full item/verb commands require a text keyboard.

cavewars-mouse-keypad-inferred-v1.description: Low-confidence hybrid: D-pad moves mouse pointer and A selects with left-click. B merges selected groups (Space), X splits (H), Y stops (A), Start advances the turn (N), and Select sends Esc. L1/R1/L2/R2 send NumPad 4/6/8/2 for selected-unit movement; exact directional keypad mapping is inferred.

champ-asterocks-joystick-v1.description: D-pad directions drive the native joystick; A fires, B triggers the secondary action (hyperspace in Classic, shield in CHAMP), X opens controller options, Start opens options, and L1 pauses.

champ-native-joystick-directions-fire-f1.description: Shared CHAMP digital joystick layout: D-pad sends native joystick 1 directions, A sends joystick button 1, and Start sends F12. Game-specific button meaning and pause behavior are recorded per game.

chaos-engine-native-joystick-keyboard-ac.description: Low-confidence native joystick movement with keyboard actions: D-pad sends joystick 1 directions; A=Ctrl fire (hold for special fire), B=Space swaps special, X=Left Shift cycles special.

circuits-edge-dpad-keyboard-menus-v1.description: Keyboard layout based on the DOS manual: D-pad arrows move and navigate; A selects with Enter; B advances text with Space; X closes a menu with Escape; Y exits a location with E; L1 opens Talk (T); R1 opens Game (G); Start sends Space for title/continue.

civilization-mouse-v1.description: Mouse-driven interface: D-pad moves the pointer, A performs left-click actions, and B performs right-click information actions.

clockwiser-native-joystick-mouse-inferre.description: Shared controller binding layout. The game-specific research row documents action meanings, input mode, and setup requirements.

clone-invader-native-joystick-dpad-infer.description: Low-confidence native joystick: D-pad drives joystick 1; A=joystick button 1 (inferred fire), B=Space fire fallback, Start=J initialize joystick, Select=Esc abort, L1=S sound.

codename-iceman-dos-native-joystick-v1.description: D-pad sends native joystick 1 directions for character movement. A=Enter selects menus/dismisses messages; B=Tab inventory; X=F3 repeats the prior command; Y=Ctrl-P pauses; L1=F5 saves; R1=F7 restores; Start=Esc opens menus. Arbitrary parser commands and submarine controls still need keyboard/pointer input.

conflagration-dpad-keyboard-v1.description: D-pad Left/Right/Down move and Up rotates right; A drops, B rotates left, X help, Y sound, L1 new game, R1 scores, Select pause, Start exits.

crazy-cars-native-joystick-v1.description: Native DOS joystick layout: D-pad Up accelerates, Down brakes, and Left/Right steer. A sends Space to continue between phases; B sends F2 to connect/disconnect joystick; Start sends F10 to pause/resume; Select sends Esc to exit.

creature-shock-mouse-v1.description: D-pad moves the mouse aim/cursor; A left-clicks to steer, fire, or select; B sends Space for a smart bomb; Start sends P to pause.

cylindrix-dpad-keyboard-controls-v1.description: Keyboard scheme from the original DOS readme: D-pad arrows steer/move; A=Ctrl laser, B=Space missile, X=x special weapon, Y=s takeoff/land, L1=Alt sidestep modifier, R1=a throttle faster, L2=z throttle slower, R2=v view, Start=Esc pause/menu, Select=Enter menu selection. F1-F12 wingman orders are not mapped.

d-generation-native-joystick-two-buttons.description: Native D/Generation joystick controls: D-pad supplies eight-way movement; A/button 1 becomes laser fire on first use, B/button 2 throws grenades. X=Enter talk to survivors; Y=U weapon menu; Start=Esc freeze/resume.

dangerous-dave-risky-rescue-native-joyst.description: D-pad drives native joystick 1; A/B are documented joystick buttons 1/2 for jump/fire. X=Ctrl+Down drops down from a platform/ladder; Y=F1 help; L1=F4 save; R1=F5 restore; Select=Space status; Start=Esc quit.

descent-joystick-v1.description: Native joystick directions and fire buttons from the D-pad/face buttons, with keyboard A/Z on shoulder buttons for forward/reverse thrust.

deus-native-joystick-dpad-actions-v1.description: D-pad sends native DOS joystick directions; A sends joystick shoot (documented as mouse-left/select/fire). B opens F1 map, X F2 computer, Y F9 weapons, L1 holds Shift to run, R1 holds Alt to crawl, L2 F3 pharmacy, R2 F4 wardrobe, Start P pauses, and Select Esc cancels panels.

dizzy-dice-slot-keyboard-inferred-v1.description: Dizzy Dice DOS keyboard layout: D-pad selects keys 1-4; A/B/X/Y/L1 send S/H/5/C/G; L2/R1/R2 send L/T/S for dice actions.

dpad-arrow-space-ctrl-inferred-v1.description: Shared low-confidence key layout: D-pad sends arrow keys, A sends Space, and B sends Ctrl. Game-specific action meanings remain inferred.

dpad-arrows-space-primary-action-v1.description: Shared layout: D-pad sends arrow keys and A sends Space. Game-specific action meaning is recorded per game.

dpad-arrows-steering-only-v1.description: Shared controller binding layout. The game-specific research row documents action meanings, input mode, and setup requirements.

dpad-cardinal-parser-commands-v1.description: Shared text-adventure layout: D-pad sends cardinal command letters, A sends Enter, and B sends I. Game-specific parser limits are recorded per game.

dpad-mouse-left-right-esc-v1.description: Shared controller binding layout. The game-specific research row documents action meanings, input mode, and setup requirements.

dpad-mouse-left-right-v1.description: Shared layout: D-pad moves the mouse cursor, A sends left click, and B sends right click. Game-specific actions and chords are recorded per game.

dpad-mouse-point-and-select-v1.description: Shared controller binding layout. The game-specific research row documents action meanings, input mode, and setup requirements.

dpad-native-joystick-directions-button1-.description: Shared controller binding layout. The game-specific research row documents action meanings, input mode, and setup requirements.

dpad-native-joystick-one-button-contextu.description: Shared controller binding layout. The game-specific research row documents action meanings, input mode, and setup requirements.

dpad-native-joystick-two-buttons-esc-men.description: Shared controller binding layout. The game-specific research row documents action meanings, input mode, and setup requirements.

dpad-native-joystick-two-buttons-v1.description: Shared controller binding layout. The game-specific research row documents action meanings, input mode, and setup requirements.

dr-wongs-jacks-video-poker-dpad-keyboard.description: Keyboard control layout for Dr. Wong's Jacks+ Video Poker (1992 DOS): D-pad arrows navigate, A=Enter, B=F3 max bet, X=F1 help, Y=F7 tutor; L1/R1/L2/R2/Select hold cards 1-5; Start=F10 ends the game after a round.

dragon-ball-keyboard-v1.description: Player-one keyboard scheme: D-pad directions plus Center on Select; face and shoulder buttons reproduce all six documented attack commands.

dragon-lore-ii-dpad-mouse-v1.description: Shared controller binding layout. The game-specific research row documents action meanings, input mode, and setup requirements.

dragons-of-flame-native-joystick-dpad-v1.description: DOS native joystick mapping: D-pad drives joystick 1; A sends joystick button 1. L1 enables joystick mode with J, Start opens menus with Space, and Select exits with Escape.

drascula-dpad-mouse-actions-v1.description: D-pad mouse movement; A=left click, B=right-click action/object panel; X/Y/L1/R1=F1-F4; L2/R2=F5/F6; Start=F8; Select=F10.

duke-nukem-trilogy-keyboard-v1.description: Keyboard fallback for all three DOS episodes: D-pad left/right walk, Up interacts, A jumps with Ctrl, B fires with Alt, Start pauses with P, and X opens F1 help.

dylan-dog-murderers-dos-keypad-v1.description: DOS keypad control: D-pad maps to keypad 8/2/4/6; A holds Shift for attack/dodge; X/Y and L1/R1 send diagonal keypad 7/9/1/3 for jumping and running; B opens the inventory with Space.

econoland-2001-dpad-decision-keys-v1.description: Documented keyboard decision shortcuts: A=Enter, B=Esc, X=P, Y=R, L1=Y, R1=T. Numeric policy values and other text must be entered with the virtual keyboard; no directional control is documented.

ega-snake-dpad-controls-v1.description: D-pad moves the snake; A=pause, B=help, X=sound, Y=talking, L1/R1 change speed, Start quits.

elite-forces-inferred-mouse-v1.description: Low-confidence RTS-style mouse recommendation: D-pad moves the cursor, A clicks, X opens the documented buy menu, Y shows documented scores, and Start quits.

emergency-mission-dpad-aim-digits-v1.description: D-pad Left/Right aim; Up/Down enter 9/0. A=/ fires, B=Backspace clears, and X/Y/L1/R1/L2/R2/Select/Start enter 1-8 for the documented dosage fields.

enigmacross-mouse-keyboard-v1.description: D-pad moves the mouse cursor; A left-clicks. B=Enter, X=Esc, Y=PgUp; L1=Delete, R1=Backspace, L2=Ctrl+Y for documented Autoclue editing.

epic-native-joystick-inferred-v1.description: Low-confidence native joystick default: D-pad sends joystick 1 directions; A/B send joystick buttons 1/2 (button roles undocumented); X=Enter next weapon; Y=S toggle shields; Start=P pause; Select=J toggles joystick/mouse mode.

espn-extreme-games-native-joystick-keybo.description: Low-confidence mixed-input layout: D-pad drives joystick 1. A=Space jump, B=S brake, X=Down crouch (except luge), Y/L1=7/9 punch left/right (except bike), R1/R2=1/3 kick left/right (except luge), Start=Enter. Native joystick axis orientation and menu behavior need in-game confirmation.

expedition-dpad-shift-arrows-v1.description: D-pad sends the documented arrows for movement. Hold L1 with a direction to send Shift+arrow and destroy a robot when charged.

faceshooter-dos-keyboard-dpad-v1.description: Faceshooter DOS keyboard controls: D-pad Left/Right send [/] to move the gun; A=backslash fires; X=Y and B=N answer the continue prompt; Start=Q exits.

fast-break-dos-keypad-v1.description: Fast Break DOS player one: D-pad sends keypad 8/2/4/6, A sends Right Shift fire, and Start sends Space for game start or timeout.

faustus-keyboard-rpg-v1.description: D-pad sends keypad 8/2/4/6; A/B/X/Y send keypad 7/9/1/3 for diagonal outdoor travel. L1=E eat, R1=Alt+S save, L2/R2/Select/Start=F1-F4 character selection.

fellowship-part2-dpad-compass-command-v1.description: Shared controller binding layout. The game-specific research row documents action meanings, input mode, and setup requirements.

firing-snake-keyboard-v1.description: D-pad sends arrow keys; A=Ctrl fire, R1=Alt speed up, Start=Esc quit.

floppy-bird-one-button-space-v1.description: One-button keyboard mapping: D-pad up and A both send Space to flap.

four-soccer-simulators-native-joystick-m.description: Prefer native DOS joystick mode: D-pad sends joystick 1 directions and A sends the single documented fire action as joystick button 1. Start=Space moves menu arrows; B=Enter selects. The manual does not number the joystick button.

frantis-mission-ii-dpad-keys-v1.description: Frantis: Mission II DOS keyboard chart: D-pad sends arrow keys; A=Space fire, B=Left Alt bombs, X=Enter interaction, Start=Esc menu exit.

funky-bubble-puzz-numpad-v1.description: D-pad left/right send keypad 4/6 to move pairs; A sends Insert to drop. The DOS-specific control listing does not identify a separate rotation command.

gadget-lost-time-dpad-arrows-action-low-.description: Low-confidence keyboard layout for the 1993 PC release: D-pad sends arrow keys for movement, jumping, and interaction; A=Ctrl uses or throws items, B=U summons/uses gadgets, X=H pauses, Start=Esc quits. Text answers may need the virtual keyboard.

global-thermonuclear-war-1985-numeric-v1.description: Global Thermonuclear War (1985): D-pad sends number keys 1-4; A/B/X/Y/L1 send 5-9. No Enter-submit key is guessed.

go-simulator-dpad-mouse-low-v1.description: Low-confidence DOS mouse layout: D-pad moves the pointer; A left-click places a stone (mouse button inferred); B=Space opens in-game options. Native DOS joystick support is unverified.

gold-hunt-keyboard-v1.description: D-pad moves; A=P pause, B=S sound toggle, X=H high scores. The block-removal penalty and quit key are left unbound.

gravitar-keyboard-v1.description: Keyboard fallback: D-pad rotates/thrusts; A fires; B shields or sucks fuel; Start exits.

gunship-2000-cd-dpad-joystick-flight-fun.description: Gunship 2000 CD-ROM: D-pad=joystick directions for menus and cyclic flight; A=Selector 1 (select/fire), B=Selector 2 (alternate/menu action/target acquisition). X=Space ordnance, Y=5 autopilot, L1=F1 cockpit, R1=F2 mast, L2=F10 GPS, R2=Alt+P pause, Select=Esc return from map. Keyboard remains needed for other simulator functions.

hack-vi-navigation-dpad-commands-v1.description: Keyboard roguelike layout: D-pad=H/K/J/L cardinal movement; L1/R1/L2/R2=Y/U/B/N diagonals; A=G get; B=F fight; X=I inventory; Y=period rest.

haebyeon-ui-baegu-keyboard-v1.description: D-pad sends WASD for player movement; A/B send documented strike keys 1/2. Jump is omitted because its availability is uncertain.

helicopter-mission-native-joystick-actio.description: Low-confidence 1994 DOS mapping: D-pad sends joystick 1 directions; A sends documented Space action; L1/R1 send documented Alt+Up/Alt+Down altitude chords. Joystick axis/button roles and chord placement are not specified by the source.

heroes-lance-joystick-one-button-menu-v1.description: D-pad sends joystick 1 directions; A sends joystick button 1 for context-sensitive combat/jump; Start sends Space to pause and open the main menu.

high-rollers-1988-dpad-keypad-numbers-v1.description: Keyboard driven quiz and dice game: D-pad Up/Down/Left/Right and A/X/Y/L1/R1 enter documented digits 8/2/4/6/5/1/3/7/9; B=Space submits the chosen number set. Start=L and Select=/ provide the documented solo buzzer keys. Quiz answers and complete menu navigation are not established.

home-alone-2-native-joystick-keyboard-lo.description: Low-confidence DOS hybrid: D-pad sends native joystick 1 directions; A=Space pickup, B=Enter use item, X=0 jump. No joystick button or menu action is guessed.

home-run-derby-keyboard-v1.description: D-pad sends arrow keys for menus. Pitch target keypad 1-9 are assigned in sequence to A, B, X, Y, L1, R1, L2, R2, Select; Start=Enter confirms.

horror-zombies-keyboard-actions-v1.description: Keyboard fallback for the DOS version: D-pad arrows move; A=Space action/fire; B=Ctrl attack; X=Alt strafe; Start=Esc menu; Y/N answer prompts.

howitzer-mouse-v1.description: D-pad moves the mouse pointer; A/B left/right click. X fires/starts with Space. L1/R1 adjust power by 10; L2/R2 set power to maximum/minimum. Y resets the aim; Start begins a game, Select opens the system menu (Alt+Z).

hugos-house-of-horrors-dpad-functions-v1.description: D-pad moves Hugo; A=Enter, B=repeat last command, X=inventory, Y=sound, L1=save, R1=restore. The virtual keyboard remains needed for typed commands.

hunt-red-october-native-joystick-v1.description: D-pad sends native joystick 1 directions to steer; A sends joystick button 1 to fire. Menu selections can use the documented Space key if needed.

hunters-law-deluxe-dpad-menu-hunt-v1.description: D-pad selects and aims. A=Enter confirm, B=Escape/back, X=P pause, Y=S send HuntPack/toggle fight health, L1/R1/L2/R2=pack speeds 1-4, Select=U reuse hunt, Start=H hunt status.

indycar2-native-joystick-dpad-v1.description: Shared controller binding layout. The game-specific research row documents action meanings, input mode, and setup requirements.

jack-flash-dpad-keys-v1.description: Jack Flash DOS keyboard controls: D-pad sends the documented arrows; A=Alt fire, B=Ctrl jump, X=T camera, Y=Enter recharge.

jetfighter-adventure-joystick-v1.description: D-pad drives native joystick flight axes; A is joystick button 1 for firing. B releases brakes, X selects missile, Y cycles target, L1 opens target display, R1 raises/lowers gear, L2 sends Shift+= for increased thrust, R2 sends - for decreased thrust, Select calibrates with Alt+J, and Start opens ILS.

jetset-1982-dpad-flight-keyboard-v1.description: D-pad keypad Up/Down pitch and comma/period rudder; A/B throttle increase/decrease, X reverse, Y flaps, L1 wheels, R1 brakes, L2 missed approach, R2 VOR frequency.

jones-fast-lane-mouse-click-chords-v1.description: D-pad moves the mouse pointer; A left-clicks. Hold R1 (Shift) with A for the documented right-click, or L1 (Ctrl) with A for middle-click. B sends F4 for statistics, X F6 for goals, Y F1 for help, Start Esc to pause, and Select F5 to save.

joust-vga-dpad-zx-alt-v1.description: Joust VGA player-one keyboard controls: D-pad left/right send Z/X, A sends Alt to flap, and Start sends Space to begin play.

judge-dredd-dos-keyboard-inferred-v1.description: Low-confidence DOS keyboard fallback: D-pad sends arrow movement; A/X send Space/Enter action; B sends Ctrl attack; Start sends Esc; L1/R1 send Y/N responses. The DOS control page and catalog differ by one year, and native joystick support is unverified.

juno-first-dos-native-joystick-v1.description: DOS manual-backed native joystick layout: D-pad moves; A sends joystick button 1 (start/fire); B sends button 2 (warp); Y selects two-player mode at the title screen; L1 sends J to select the standard joystick type; Select sends Space to pause.

karateka-1986-dos-native-joystick-v1.description: Native IBM DOS joystick: D-pad maps to Joystick 1, with up/down controlling stance and strike height and left/right advancing or retreating. A=joystick button 2 punch/bow; B=button 1 kick. No analog stick.

kick-off-3-dos-1994-native-joystick-dpad.description: Exact 1994 DOS Kick Off 3 joystick mapping: D-pad drives native Joystick 1; B drives joystick button 2, which the DOS review identifies as pass. Joystick button 1 is left unassigned because its action was not established by the exact DOS source.

kings-beach-native-joystick-actions-v1.description: Native joystick layout: D-pad sends joystick 1 directions; A/B send joystick buttons 1/2. Press A+B together for sky-ball serve, spike, or block according to play context. L1 pauses with P, X opens the F3 stat screen, and Start returns to the beach with Escape.

larn-vi-movement-dpad-v1.description: D-pad maps to Larn movement commands K/J/H/L for up/down/left/right.

laura-bow2-mouse-keyboard-v1.description: D-pad moves the pointer; A clicks, B right-clicks to cycle cursors, X opens the icon bar with Escape, Y cycles cursors with Enter, and L1 moves between menu choices with Tab.

lemmings-3d-winterland-keyboard-dpad-v1.description: D-pad uses documented T/F/G/V pointer movement; A=Space left click, B/X=A/S rotate world, Y=Enter fast-forward, L1=P pause, Start=F11 quit confirmation.

lemmings-v1.description: Native joystick navigation from the D-pad, joystick button clicks, and keyboard skill shortcuts on face/shoulder buttons; no stick input.

loopz-dos-native-joystick-v1.description: D-pad sends native joystick 1 directions. A rotates with joystick button 1; B drops with joystick button 2. Start sends Shift to pause or restart.

los-justicieros-dpad-mouse-left-click-v1.description: D-pad moves the mouse pointer and A clicks to fire.

lost-digital-reality-native-joystick-key.description: Low-confidence joystick movement with documented action keys: D-pad sends joystick 1 directions; A activates objects, B selects mode, X faces forward, Y U-turns.

lost-tribe-dpad-mouse-v1.description: D-pad moves the mouse pointer; A left-clicks to select, B right-clicks for documented context actions, and Start sends Ctrl-Q to quit.

magiduck-dpad-keyboard-v1.description: D-pad Left/Right walk and Down looks down; A=Z jump/fly, B=X shoot, Select=Enter, Start=Esc.

magnetik-tank-keypad-inferred-v1.description: Low-confidence candidate: D-pad sends NumPad 8/2/4/6 for directional tank movement; A sends Ctrl and B sends Alt as candidate fire keys. Verify the fire key and native DOS joystick support.

math-rescue-native-joystick-inferred-v1.description: Low-confidence native joystick mapping: D-pad sends joystick 1 directions; A=button 1 jump and B=button 2 slime, as documented in the Math Rescue manual.

maximum-overdrive-keyboard-player-one-v1.description: Player 1 keyboard layout: D-pad arrows accelerate, brake, steer; A=Delete fire; B=Insert select weapon; X=Page Down handbrake; Y=End horn.

medieval-chess-joystick-v1.description: Native joystick directions and Action with input-device selection, pause, and menu access.

megapede-dpad-mouse-shooter-v1.description: D-pad mouse movement; A=left fire, B=right energized attack, L1=pause, R1=sound, Start=quit.

mice-maze-keyboard-v1.description: D-pad moves; A=Space bomb activation, then D-pad selects direction; B=M map, X=H help, Y=O sound, L1=C scoreboard.

mick-keyboard-platform-inventory-v1.description: D-pad Left/Right moves and Up jumps or climbs. A opens the potions inventory (Space); B opens the amulets inventory (Enter). These controls are documented after Mick regains human form.

minervga-keyboard-v1.description: D-pad sends arrow keys; A=E enter building, B=D drill, X=P pump, Y=Y dynamite, L1=T elevator top, R1=B elevator bottom, Start=H help, Select=R restore, L2=Q quiet, R2=S save and end.

moo2-dpad-mouse-click-keys-v1.description: Master of Orion II DOS mouse-first layout: D-pad moves the pointer; A/B left/right click; X=Enter (left-click equivalent), Y=Esc (cancel/back), Start=Alt+Q (quit).

mortal-kombat-3-keyboard-full-actions-v1.description: D-pad uses the documented Player 1 arrows (up=jump, down=duck); A/X/B/Y are low/high punch and low/high kick; L1 blocks, R1 runs. Select confirms menu choices, Start sends F1 to begin, and L2 sends P to pause.

murder-in-museum-dpad-parser-v1.description: D-pad sends compass N/S/E/W; A=Enter, B=I inventory, X=H help. Virtual keyboard handles other commands.

nam-1965-1975-dpad-mouse-inferred-v1.description: Low-confidence DOS keyboard mouse emulation: D-pad sends documented cursor-direction keys A/Z/comma/period; A sends Space, documented as mouse down and treated as a click/select.

native-joystick-directions-only-dpad-v1.description: D-pad directions send native Joystick 1 up/down/left/right. Use only when game-specific evidence supports directional joystick control and no button role is established.

nba-jam-te-native-joystick-keyboard-acti.description: NBA Jam Tournament Edition DOS: D-pad maps to native joystick 1 directions; A/B send the documented DOS keyboard shoot/pass keys. Turbo is unbound because its DOS keyboard control was not verified.

nightmare-elm-street-dpad-numpad-items-v.description: DOS numeric keypad movement and keyboard inventory actions: D-pad directions use keypad 8/4/6/2, A uses the selected item with keypad 5, L1/R1 cycle items with A/Z, B drops with D, and Start opens the menu with Escape.

nitro-racers-native-joystick-inferred-v1.description: Low-confidence native joystick preset: D-pad directions drive joystick 1; A uses documented Enter/Nitro, B pauses, and Start ends the race. Exact joystick axis and button roles were not available in the sources.

obliterator-dos-keyboard-v1.description: D-pad moves; A is Space for aim/fire and directional action chords; B/X/Y/L1 select F1/F2/F3/F4 weapons.

olympic-soccer-native-joystick-inferred-.description: Low-confidence DOS-gamepad layout: D-pad sends native joystick 1 directions; A/B/X/Y/L1/R1 send six digital joystick buttons. In the game Setup program, assign four face buttons to shoot/pass/chip/cross; reserve shoulders for the two less-used actions. The sources confirm remapping and button roles, but not factory button numbering.

ontarget-dpad-keyboard-controls-v1.description: D-pad selects and adjusts cannon Angle/Speed. A=Space fire, X=Insert add player, Start=Enter confirm, B=Escape quit.

paddlers-player-one-dpad-v1.description: D-pad arrow keys control Player 1; Select pauses, Start returns to title.

pandora-directive-dpad-mouse-keyboard-v1.description: D-pad moves the mouse in movement and interactive modes; A left-clicks the current action, B right-clicks to cycle actions or stop movement, X=Space switches modes, Y=R runs while moving, L1/R1 tilt view, L2/R2 raise/lower height. Text entry uses the virtual keyboard.

pc-futbol-4-native-joystick-mouse-ui-inf.description: D-pad directions control native joystick 1 in matches; A sends joystick button 1 (role inferred). B left-clicks; L1/R1/L2/R2 move the mouse pointer up/down/left/right in the graphical interface. X=F1 home-team substitution, Y=F5 away-team substitution, Start=F9 pause.

pc-gammon-dpad-mouse-roll-v1.description: D-pad mouse movement; A selects checker/destination, B rolls with Space, Start returns to DOS.

pc-monopoly-numbered-menu-v1.description: A-F map main menu actions 1-6; Y confirms purchase. Use the virtual keyboard for negotiation and text entry.

peach-the-lobster-keyboard-arrows-gh-v1.description: Exact DOS keyboard layout: D-pad sends arrow keys (left/right move, up jumps, down crouches); A=G fires left and B=H fires right. Up can be tapped twice for a high jump. No native joystick is listed; run/slide controls were not found.

personal-nightmare-dpad-mouse-command-v1.description: IBM PC/DOS mouse layout: D-pad moves the mouse pointer; A=left click selects verbs, compass directions, and objects; B=right click submits a command; X=Enter is the manual-documented alternate command submission. ASK/SHOW/SAVE text commands still need the virtual keyboard.

planet-siege-mouse-inferred-v1.description: Low-confidence RTS recommendation: D-pad moves the mouse pointer, A selects/issues point-and-select orders, X sends C to cancel construction, and Y sends B to build the selected item.

popeye-3-dos-arrows-ctrl-alt-space-v1.description: Low-confidence DOS keyboard layout: D-pad sends documented arrow keys; A=Space, B=Ctrl, and X=Alt send the three documented action keys. Individual action meanings are unspecified.

prince-of-persia-v1.description: Keyboard movement with the original Shift action key.

prison-amok-mouse-v1.description: D-pad controls mouse position; A fires with left click, B reloads/selects with right click, and Y sends Space to clear screen clutter.

project-neptune-native-joystick-context-.description: Native joystick layout for Project Neptune: D-pad drives joystick 1, A fires with joystick button 1, B sends Return to toggle submarine/cursor control or engage autopilot, X sends Esc to return from map/PDP activity, and Start sends P to pause.

qikserve-dpad-serve-buttons-v1.description: D-pad moves the server; A/B/X serve hamburger, shake, and fries.

quadralien-dos-keyboard-dpad-contextual-.description: DOS keyboard layout: D-pad uses the documented direction keys (apostrophe up, slash down, Z left, X right). A=Enter laser, B=Space context action, X/Y/L1/R1/L2=F1-F5, Select/Start=F9/F10 pause/resume.

queen-eye-configurable-keyboard-low-v1.description: Low-confidence configurable keyboard layout for the 1998 DOS release. Configure in-game: D-pad arrows=forward/back/turn; A/B=punch 1/2; X/Y=kick 1/2; L1=block; R1=jump; L2=dodge; Select=Delete pickup. Proposed action keys are not claimed to be the original defaults.

quik-thunder-rabbit-dos-keyboard-low-v1.description: Low-confidence keyboard fallback for Quik the Thunder Rabbit (DOS 1994): D-pad sends arrow keys; A sends Ctrl and B sends Space as competing reported attack keys.

rad-warrior-native-joystick-v1.description: D-pad drives native joystick 1; A sends joystick button 1 for the documented context-sensitive fire action; Select sends Q to quit/restart.

rampcube-keyboard-v1.description: Manual-backed keyboard layout: D-pad sends arrow keys to move the catcher; A sends Space to drop the tile; Start sends P to pause; X sends C for previous scores; Y sends S for sound toggle (also used contextually at the save prompt); Select sends Q to quit.

rbi-baseball-2-1991-dos-keyboard-pad-v1.description: Documented DOS keyboard controls: D-pad arrows, A=Enter, B=Backspace, Start=F1 timeout, Select=F3 options.

requiem-heavyweight-keyboard-nav-inferre.description: D-pad sends arrow keys to move through boxer, round, and style choices; A sends Enter to confirm; B sends Esc to back out. Exact DOS menu keys were not found, so this is a low-confidence keyboard-menu inference.

reversi-1985-dpad-select-v1.description: D-pad moves the board pointer; A places a move, B aborts, X forfeits a turn.

riva-mouse-two-button-v1.description: D-pad moves the mouse pointer; A begins travel or activates an item with left-click; B opens the available-options menu with right-click; L1 holds Shift to run; Start sends Esc.

robot-iii-keyboard-v1.description: D-pad moves; shoulder buttons provide the four documented diagonal directions; A confirms/opens the backpack, B opens the in-game menu, X/Y provide help and scene restart, Start begins a game, Select saves.

robotron-2084-1995-joystick-keypad-infer.description: Low-confidence combined-input layout for the exact 1995 DOS port: D-pad sends joystick 1 movement; A/B/X/Y and shoulders send keypad directions for independent fire. Start sends Enter; Select sends Escape. Joystick movement is inferred from the documented joystick+keyboard mode.

rott-dark-war-native-joystick-v1.description: D-pad sends native joystick 1 directions for movement/turning. A is joystick button 1 (fire), B button 2 (use/open). X toggles weapons; Y turns 180 degrees; L1/R1 sidestep; Select shows the map; Start opens the main menu.

rygar-1996-keypad-controls-v1.description: D-pad sends keypad 8/2/4/6 movement; A=Ctrl jump, B=Alt fire, L1=coin, Start=1Up, R1=2Up.

sea-legends-keyboard-v1.description: D-pad controls ship, sails, and fencing; A shoots, B fires cannon salvo, X changes target, Y calls boatswain, Select opens map, Start opens menu out of battle, L+direction changes view, and R fast-forwards.

second-front-keyboard-v1.description: D-pad sends keypad 8/2/4/6; A/B/X/Y send keypad 7/9/1/3 for eight-way map movement. L1=Enter, R1=Space; L2/R2/Select/Start send I/M/J/K for large map scroll.

secret-of-monkey-island-joystick-v1.description: Native DOS joystick cursor control: D-pad moves the cursor, button 1 selects, button 2 applies the highlighted verb; keyboard shortcuts cover pause/save and joystick toggle.

secret-silver-blades-native-joystick-men.description: D-pad drives the native joystick for movement. A confirms with Enter, B undoes a move with Escape, X/Y/L1/R1 send cursor keys to navigate commands, and L2 sends Space to return the party from Quick mode.

sensible-soccer-92-93-native-joystick-in.description: Low-confidence DOS joystick default: D-pad drives joystick 1; A sends joystick button 1 as the inferred primary kick/action. Start=P pauses; Select=Escape abandons the match. Exact DOS joystick button semantics remain unverified.

set-hostages-free-fire-inferred-v1.description: Low-confidence single-action candidate: A sends Space to shoot; directional input is omitted because the reviewed game description says the gun rotates automatically.

shadow-knights-native-joystick-v1.description: D-pad sends joystick 1 directions; A/button 1=Ctrl jump, B/button 2=Alt sword attack; Select=F4 joystick configuration, Start=Esc quit.

shadow-of-the-comet-dos-keyboard-gamepad.description: DOS keyboard mapping: D-pad=arrows, A=Tab icon bar, B=Enter confirm/scroll, X=G Get, Y=U Use, L1=T Talk, R1=L Look, Select=O inventory, Start=P pause, L2=I diary, R2=D disk menu.

silent-hunter-commanders-edition-mouse-v.description: D-pad moves the mouse pointer; A left-clicks and B right-clicks to open Abort Mission. X/Y and shoulders open documented submarine stations.

simisle-dpad-mouse-shoulder-navigation-v.description: D-pad moves the mouse pointer; A selects/interacts. L1/R1/L2/R2 send arrow keys for map movement. B opens statistics (S), Y toggles map view (M), Start pauses (P), and Select sends Esc.

skyroads-native-joystick-jump-inferred-v.description: Low-confidence native joystick recommendation: D-pad sends joystick 1 directions and A sends joystick button 1 for jumping. Start sends the documented P pause key.

snipes-keyboard-dual-direction-inferred-.description: D-pad arrows control movement. X/Y/A/B send A/S/W/D for separate four-way fire; L1 sends Space for the speed boost. Low-confidence layout pending the exact manual.

space-assault-2017-dpad-four-weapons-v1.description: D-pad Left/Right moves; A/B/X/Y fire with Z/X/C/V; Select pauses, Start quits.

spellcraft-dpad-keypad-controls-v1.description: D-pad sends numeric keypad 8/2/4/6. A=Enter select/place/cast, B=Escape cancel, X=Insert sword combat, Y=Space map/status, L1+ D-pad uses Shift spell-menu navigation, R1=X Return Home.

star-quest-i-native-joystick-dpad-v1.description: D-pad native joystick directions; A=fire, B=roll; L1/R1 previous/next weapon; Start pauses to menu.

starball-dos-keyboard-pinball-v1.description: Exact DOS keyboard actions: D-pad Left=Left Shift left flipper; D-pad Right=Right Shift right flipper; A=Right Shift also launches the ball; B=Ctrl table shake/nudge; Start=F12 controls list. Native joystick support is unverified.

starship-commander-tbs-dpad-mouse-v1.description: Exact DOS tactical controls: D-pad moves the mouse pointer, A clicks, B opens menus, X/Y cycle unit selection, shoulders map the documented F1-F4 control transfers, and Start exits. Keyboard-only navigation and Alt hotkeys remain available through the virtual keyboard.

stealth-affair-dpad-mouse-full-controls-.description: Source-backed IBM/DOS mouse layout: D-pad moves the pointer, A=left click, B=right click (hold A+B for the user menu); X/Y/L1/R1/L2/R2=F1-F6 (Examine/Take/Inventory/Use/Operate/Speak); Select=F9 action menu; Start=F10 user menu. Keyboard arrows can move the cursor and QWE/ASD/ZXC move Bond directly.

stratego-1990-dos-native-joystick-dpad-i.description: Low-confidence native joystick inference for Stratego (1990 DOS): D-pad drives Joystick 1 directions to move the board pointer and A maps to joystick button 1 for select/click. DOS joystick support and pointer-driven board/menu interface are documented, but exact joystick axes and button roles are not.

tag-team-wrestling-native-joystick-one-b.description: DOS manual-backed native joystick layout: D-pad drives joystick 1, A sends fire for attack selection/execution, L1/R1 send F1/F2 for player and joystick count, Start sends F3, and Select pauses with Escape.

tankgame-native-joystick-dpad-inferred-v.description: Low-confidence hybrid: D-pad sends native DOS joystick 1 directions for driving; A sends Space to fire. L1 toggles reserve weapon (Tab); Select toggles sound (F1); Start exits (Esc). No analog stick or joystick button role is assumed.

temple-of-kroz-dpad-keyboard-actions-v1.description: Medium-confidence keyboard mapping from the 1990 DOS page: D-pad sends arrow movement; A/B send Ctrl/Alt shooting actions; X sends Enter to use; Start sends Space to start/select; Select sends Esc for the menu.

tetris-hvb-1992-keypad-v1.description: D-pad left/right send NumPad 4/6; down sends NumPad 2 to drop; A sends Space to rotate.

textmode-tetris-native-joystick-inferred.description: Low-confidence native joystick default: D-pad sends joystick 1 directions; A/B send joystick buttons 1/2. The manual confirms joystick/gamepad support but not button roles. Start sends F2 for a new game; Select sends P to pause. Keyboard fallback documented by the manual: D-pad up rotates counter-clockwise, B sends Space for clockwise rotation, and down drops.

tfx-native-joystick-dpad-fire-keyboard-v.description: Native TFX joystick flight on the D-pad. In mouse menus, L1/R1/L2/R2 move the pointer and B clicks. A sends Space to fire/release weapons; Start sends Enter; X pauses with P; Y increases thrust; Select decreases thrust. Configure TFX to use joystick flight.

thomas-tank-engine-dos-native-joystick-f.description: DOS PC joystick controls with D-pad movement, one fire button, F1 pause, and Esc abort.

time-commando-dpad-keyboard-actions-v1.description: D-pad sends arrow keys for movement and menu navigation. A sends Ctrl to attack; A+Down produces the documented parry. B sends Space for Search/Action and menu selection. L1+Left/Right sends Alt+Arrow for lateral dodge. Start sends Esc for the in-game menu.

tmnt-dos-native-joystick-dpad-v1.description: Native DOS joystick on the D-pad: arrows move the turtle, A is joystick fire (tap to attack, hold to jump), B selects weapons with Space, X activates special features with Enter, Start pauses with Ctrl+P, Select opens the information screen with Esc, and Y saves with Ctrl+S.

tommy-gtw-command-pad-v1.description: Keyboard command helper: D-pad directions enter M, Enter, Backspace, and A. Face/shoulder buttons enter digits 0-9 for the documented Mxx/Axx city commands; Enter submission is inferred.

tommys-air-raid-dpad-keyboard-v1.description: D-pad selects and raises/lowers gun batteries; A/B set missile burst altitude; X/Y lower/raise all batteries; shoulders adjust slew and sound; Select shows instructions; Start quits.

tommys-space-goblins-numpad-inferred-v1.description: Low-confidence keyboard fallback: D-pad sends numpad 8/2/4/6 for ship movement; A sends Space for the proton beam. The DOS source names numeric-keypad movement and beam firing but does not identify individual keys.

total-carnage-twin-control-inferred-v1.description: D-pad sends joystick 1 directions for movement; A/B/X/Y send joystick 2 up/right/left/down for directional fire. Hold two aim buttons for a diagonal. Start sends Enter as an inferred menu/start fallback.

total-eclipse-native-joystick-keyboard-a.description: Configure Total Eclipse for native joystick at startup and complete joystick centering. D-pad maps to joystick 1 movement/sight directions; A fires joystick button 1. B=Space draws/replaces pistol, X=F faces forward, Y=U makes a U-turn, L1=H crouches/stands, and Start=I interrupts the game.

troddlers-keyboard-action-chords-v1.description: D-pad moves the wizard; hold A for Ctrl or B for Alt with a D-pad direction to place a block.

tronic-keyboard-arrows-alt-v1.description: D-pad sends arrow keys to move the paddle; A holds Alt to charge and fire Gigablitz rockets.

turbo-1987-dpad-throttle-v1.description: D-pad Left/Right steers and Up/Down shifts; hold A for Shift throttle.

turn-n-burn-native-joystick-v1.description: D-pad sends joystick 1 directions; A=fire. X=3 calibrates/selects joystick in setup; Y=Space advances menus; Start=F1 pause, Select=F2 resume.

tyrian-2000-v1.description: Native joystick controls on the D-pad and face buttons; X/Y retain the manual-documented Ctrl/Alt sidekick keys.

under-the-ice-keyboard-adventure-v1.description: D-pad enters uppercase N/S/W/E; A submits; B=inventory, X=help, Y=up, L1=down. Shift chords produce uppercase letters; longer verbs/object commands need text entry.

universe-ii-dos-keyboard-menu-v1.description: DOS keyboard-menu fallback: Start=Esc enables keyboard menu selection; D-pad sends arrow keys and A=Return selects. Context-sensitive hotkeys and starport text-parser commands require the virtual keyboard; mouse remains a supported alternative.

universe-navigation-commands-v1.description: D-pad Up/Down navigate documented lists. A sends F2 Select, B sends F3 Option, and Start sends F1 Start. Free text entry remains available through the virtual keyboard.

untouchables-native-joystick-inferred-v1.description: Low-confidence native joystick layout: D-pad drives joystick 1; A sends joystick button 1 for fire (button role inferred); X/Y/L1/R1 select characters with F1-F4; Start sends F5 pause.

vanguard-ace-dpad-joystick-key-actions-l.description: Vanguard Ace low-confidence native layout: D-pad to Joystick 1 directions; A=Ctrl fire; B=Left Alt Super Bomb. Exact joystick button roles are undocumented.

warcraft-orcs-humans-dpad-mouse-v1.description: Mouse-first DOS mapping: D-pad moves the pointer, A selects with the left button, B=Esc cancels a just-issued menu command, X=F10 opens the game menu. Use A clicks for all menu selections. Hold A while moving the D-pad to box-select or scroll at map edges.

wing-commander-1990-native-joystick-v1.description: Wing Commander (1990 DOS), native joystick. D-pad drives joystick 1; A/B are joystick buttons 1/2 (both together fire missiles/mines); B+direction adjusts speed/roll and B double-click fires afterburners. X/Y select gun/weapon type (G/W), L1/R1 target/lock (T/L), L2/R2 autopilot/navigation (A/N), Select pauses (P), Start sends Esc.

wings-of-glory-dpad-native-joystick-infe.description: Low-confidence DOS flight-sim default: D-pad steers through native joystick 1 axes; A sends joystick button 1 (primary fire inferred); B sends documented Alt+B break-and-attack; Select opens documented Alt+O options. Throttle keys and other joystick-button roles remain unverified.

wings-of-thunder-native-joystick-keyboar.description: D-pad controls native joystick 1 flight axes. A=Space fire, B=Backspace weapon select, X=F flares, Y=E engine toggle, L1/R1 = and - throttle, Start=Esc options, Select=Alt+P pause.

wings-p1-keyboard-flight-v1.description: D-pad Up/Left/Right thrust and turn; Down fires weapon 2; A fires normal gun; Start pauses/quits.

wipeout-native-joystick-v1.description: D-pad left/right send native joystick 1 steering; up/down send arrow keys for menus. A sends joystick button 2 to accelerate; B sends button 1 to deploy weapons. X sends Enter to confirm menus; L1/R1 send Z/X for air brakes, and Start sends P to pause.

witch-hunt-parser-directions-v1.description: D-pad sends the documented one-letter cardinal parser commands; free-form commands remain unavailable.

wizardry-vii-dos-keyboard-pad-v1.description: Keyboard mode: D-pad arrows move forward/back and turn; L2/R2 sidestep; A=Enter select, B=Esc cancel, X=Space field/spell select, Y=M magic, L1=Shift run, R1=NumPad 0 climb/swim, L2=Shift+comma and R2=Shift+period sidestep, Select=R rest, Start=D disk options. Configure the game for Keyboard input first.

wizards-crown-keyboard-command-pad-v1.description: Keyboard recommendation for the documented DOS controls. D-pad emits both arrow keys for menu navigation and cardinal numeric-keypad movement. A/B/X send common visible commands S/C/M; Y opens the help command; R1 returns from help; Start sends Space to begin. Diagonal keypad movement is not mapped.

wolfenstein-3d-joystick-v1.description: Native joystick on the D-pad: button 1 fires and button 2 strafes; X opens doors/activates elevators.

wordle-dpad-letter-selector-v1.description: D-pad moves selector; A selects, B clears; X directions, Y options, L1 new game, Start quits, L2/R2 option 1/2.

world-quest-native-joystick-v1.description: D-pad sends native joystick directions; A=button 1 missiles, B=button 2 bomb, X=Space nuke, L1=F1 pause, Start=Esc end game.

yo_joe_beat_ghosts-dos-keyboard-dpad-v1.description: Keyboard-only DOS controls on the physical pad: D-pad arrows move/jump/crouch and pick up; A=Space action/hit; X=Down+Space changes weapon; Start=F9 main menu; Select=Esc exit. No analog stick.

zaxxon-joystick-v1.description: Native DOS joystick controls with menu selection and start.
